description: Small exact randomisation verification of the within-example label-permutation test. Pre-registered before running; v1 config (p5_first_run.json) is preserved unchanged.
seed_scheme: seeds.seed_v2 over {experiment, joint, condition, example, replicate, branch, component, design}; SHA-256 of canonical JSON; fresh rows per dataset
statistic: T = mean over conditioning examples of ED_V(direct_i, sequential_i); target level on z, joint level = mean over 8 fixed directions of the projected ED_V on standardised (y, z); vectors relabelled as units. Upper-tail test. For equal group sizes the V- and U-statistic versions give identical permutation p-values.
randomisation: within each conditioning example, pooled 2M samples; branch labels reassigned uniformly over all C(2M, M) allocations; never across examples; product group over examples

p_value_rules.exact: p = #{g in G: T(g) >= T_obs - tol} / |G|, G includes the observed allocation
p_value_rules.ties: counted as at least as extreme (conservative); tol = 1e-12 (1 + |T|)

exchangeability_assumption: within each example the M direct samples are i.i.d., the M sequential samples are i.i.d. (fresh intermediate per sample), and the two sets are independent; no shared latent across samples and no common random numbers across branches

component_A.purpose: implementation check: exact conditional size <= alpha over the full permutation group, including ties
component_A.pass_criterion: for every dataset and alpha: #{g: p(g) <= alpha} <= alpha |G| (deterministic property; any violation = implementation bug)

component_B.purpose: Monte Carlo p-value agrees with the exact p-value and is never 0
component_B.pass_criterion: |p_mc - p_exact| <= 4 sqrt(p_exact (1 - p_exact) / (B+1)) + 1/(B+1) and p_mc >= 1/(B+1) for all datasets

component_C.purpose: unconditional rejection rates with exact p-values (|G| = 20^3 = 8000) under H0 and fixed alternatives, with always-accept and always-reject negative-control detectors

cells.note: target marginal is exactly the direct law, so this is a target-level null

engineering_diagnostics.excess_flag: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson LOWER bound of the null rejection rate > alpha (evidence of anti-conservativeness beyond Monte Carlo noise). Not flagging does NOT prove size <= alpha.
engineering_diagnostics.powered_flag: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson LOWER bound of the alternative rejection rate > alpha (better than any data-independent level-alpha rule)
engineering_diagnostics.negative_controls: always-accept must be NOT_POWERED; always-reject must be EXCESS_FLAGGED; otherwise the diagnostics are uninformative

component_C.multiplicity: engineering diagnostics reported cell by cell; no family-wise claim

component_D.purpose: timing smoke only (no inference) to extrapolate the cost of P5-E8-CALIB

budget.note: remaining approved synthetic budget is ambiguous (see STATUS.md); run capped at 30 s and recorded in the compute ledger

independence: each dataset has its own conditioning rows and sample seeds; datasets are the replication units; permutations and generated samples are not units
